title: Privacy Policy
description: BOTIA privacy policy: how data is processed when you scan food labels.
privacy_section_1_text: BOTIA is a food transparency tool. It reads ingredient lists from food labels and provides information based on scientific and regulatory evidence. BOTIA does not track, profile, or monetise personal data.
privacy_data_intro: BOTIA processes the following data when you use the app:
privacy_data_ingredient_text: — scanned or manually entered food labels. These are processed locally on your device and are not stored on our servers.
privacy_data_language_text: — stored in your browser's local storage to display BOTIA in your preferred language. Not transmitted to any server.
privacy_data_google_text: — if you sign in, Google manages your credentials. BOTIA does not access your password or personal Google data beyond basic authentication.
privacy_section_3_text_1: BOTIA's Muslim Choice and Woman modules process information that may reveal religious beliefs or health-related concerns. This processing occurs
privacy_section_3_text_2: . BOTIA does not store, transmit, or infer your religious affiliation, gender, or health status. No special category data leaves your phone.
privacy_section_4_text: BOTIA does not build personal food profiles. It does not store your scan history. It does not track what you eat. Each scan is independent and leaves no trace on our servers.
privacy_section_5_text: BOTIA's website uses local storage (not cookies) to remember your language preference. No tracking cookies, advertising cookies, or third-party analytics are used.
privacy_section_6_text: BOTIA uses Google authentication for account management. Google's privacy policy applies to that interaction. BOTIA does not share any data with advertisers, data brokers, or analytics platforms.

privacy_section_7_text: Processing of special category data (religious/health) is not performed on our servers. It occurs only on your device, for your personal use.
